name-01.output: Lin Xiao, how come you're here so early today?
name-01.direct: Lin Xiao, why did you come so early today?
name-01.reflect: 直译准确自然，'来得这么早'在英文口语中常说 'come in so early' 或 'get here so early'，更符合日常对话语气。
name-01.free: Lin Xiao, how come you're here so early today?

context-01.output: Don't worry, I've got it memorized.
context-01.direct: Don't worry, I've already memorized it thoroughly.
context-01.reflect: 直译准确自然。'背熟了'指把内容背得滚瓜烂熟，英文用 memorized it 或 got it memorized 都地道，语气轻松安抚，符合原意。
context-01.free: Don't worry, I've got it memorized.

slang-01.output: That move was way too slick—I'm absolutely losing it.
slang-01.direct: This wave of operations is too showy, I directly split open.
slang-01.reflect: 直译完全不通：'这波操作'是网络用语指'这一系列举动/这波操作'，'秀'指厉害/骚气，'裂开'是网络梗表示震惊到崩溃。需要用地道英文网络表达。
slang-01.free: That move was way too slick—I'm absolutely losing it.

idiom-01.direct: This of yours is simply drawing legs on a snake.
idiom-01.reflect: 直译保留了成语字面，但英文读者不懂这个典故；英语里有对应习语 gild the lily，表示多此一举、画蛇添足，更地道。

short-01.reflect: 单字应答，语气平淡，英文用 Yeah 或 Mm 都自然；此处用 Yeah 简洁对应。

corpus-01.output: Teacher, I really did my homework, but the dog ate it.
corpus-01.direct: Teacher, I really did write my homework, but it was eaten by the dog.
corpus-01.reflect: 直译准确，但英文里"dog ate my homework"是众所周知的借口梗，用过去时"the dog ate it"更地道自然，语气是学生辩解、略带委屈，保留即可。
corpus-01.free: Teacher, I really did my homework, but the dog ate it.

corpus-02.output: That head tilt was totally you sneaking a peek at the words!
corpus-02.direct: That tilt of the head was sneaking a peek at the words!
corpus-02.reflect: 直译准确传达了意思，但英文里'偷看词'更自然的说法是'peeking at the lyrics/script'，需根据场景判断'词'指什么；这里没有明确上下文，用'words'或'lines'较通用，语气是调侃揭穿，保留感叹语气。
corpus-02.free: That head tilt was totally you sneaking a peek at the words!

corpus-03.output: Not dating. Keeping a little mystery is nice.
corpus-03.direct: Not dating, keeping a sense of mystery is pretty good.
corpus-03.reflect: “不处”是网络口语，指不处对象、不谈恋爱；“保持神秘感”直译即可。语气轻松随意，英文用口语化的说法更自然。
corpus-03.free: Not dating. Keeping a little mystery is nice.

corpus-04.reflect: 直译生硬，不符合英语口语习惯。原文表达对某事来得突然的惊讶，英语常用 That was so sudden 或 This is so sudden 来表达。

corpus-05.output: It's just—hahaha, that's so random. Like, who even gets this?
corpus-05.direct: It's just hahaha too abstract, who understands this question
corpus-05.reflect: “太抽象了”是网络用语，指事情离谱、难以理解，直译 abstract 英文观众也能懂但不够口语；“谁懂啊”是流行语，表示共鸣式吐槽，不是真的问谁懂，应译成反问感叹语气。
corpus-05.free: It's just—hahaha, that's so random. Like, who even gets this?

corpus-06.output: I think it's true—I even came across leaked clips from his concert.
corpus-06.direct: Seems like it's true, I even scrolled to leaked videos of his concert.
corpus-06.reflect: "刷到" means came across while scrolling (social media), "路透" refers to leaked/spoiler footage from the event. "好像是真的" responds to something—likely confirming a rumor. Natural English would say "I think it's true" or "Seems real."
corpus-06.free: I think it's true—I even came across leaked clips from his concert.

corpus-07.output: Which class meeting? How come nobody told me?
corpus-07.direct: Which class meeting? How come I didn't hear about it?
corpus-07.reflect: “班会”指班级会议，“我怎么没听着”是口语化的反问，表达没被通知到的疑惑/不满。直译基本准确，但“hear about it”更自然，语气保留反问。
corpus-07.free: Which class meeting? How come nobody told me?

corpus-08.output: Plus, his honest, easygoing vibe makes him so relatable. You're not losing out here—you might even score a free meal off that face of his.
corpus-08.direct: Besides, his honest and simple temperament is so down-to-earth and approachable. You're not losing out this time—you might even get a free meal off that face.
corpus-08.reflect: 直译基本准确，但'憨厚老实的气质'和'亲民'在英文里需要更口语化的表达；'你这波不亏'是网络用语，意思是'这波操作你不亏'，应译为'you're not losing out'或'you come out ahead'；'蹭顿饭'是蹭饭，用'get a free meal'或'score a free meal'更地道。
corpus-08.free: Plus, his honest, easygoing vibe makes him so relatable. You're not losing out here—you might even score a free meal off that face of his.

corpus-09.output: Should we throw this souvenir away?
corpus-09.direct: Should this souvenir be thrown away?
corpus-09.reflect: 直译准确自然，'要不要'表达的是征询意见，英文用'Should we...'更口语化，符合日常对话语气。
corpus-09.free: Should we throw this souvenir away?

corpus-10.output: That idea of yours is pretty out there.
corpus-10.direct: Your idea is also abstract enough.
corpus-10.reflect: 直译生硬，'够抽象的'是网络用语，指想法离谱、奇葩，英文应表达'想法很离谱/奇怪'，语气带调侃。
corpus-10.free: That idea of yours is pretty out there.

corpus-11.output: Fine, I'll deal with all that toxic motivational crap when I get back home.
corpus-11.direct: Fine, wait until I return to the country to deal with these poisonous chicken soups.
corpus-11.reflect: "毒鸡汤" is internet slang for toxic motivational quotes/feel-good platitudes that are actually harmful or misleading. "处理" here means to deal with/take care of them. "行" is an agreeing "fine/alright." Direct translation of "poisonous chicken soup" would confuse English viewers; better to render the meaning as toxic motivational quotes or fake inspirational nonsense.
corpus-11.free: Fine, I'll deal with all that toxic motivational crap when I get back home.

corpus-12.output: That short? Hit a creative block?
corpus-12.direct: So short, did you hit a creative bottleneck?
corpus-12.reflect: 直译准确，但"创作瓶颈"在口语英文里更常说"creative block"，"这么短"指内容篇幅短，用"That short"更自然，语气是调侃式反问，保留。
corpus-12.free: That short? Hit a creative block?

corpus-14.output: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT—who comes out on top?
corpus-14.direct: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT—who comes out on top?
corpus-14.reflect: “方案”指提案/计划，“vs”保留对比感，“谁更胜一筹”是口语化的比较，英文用“who comes out on top”自然贴切，保留PPT一词符合职场语境。
corpus-14.free: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT—who comes out on top?

corpus-15.output: Just look at that smug, know-it-all expression—you can tell something's up. That kind of straight-faced nonsense is comedy gold.
corpus-15.direct: Just look at that expression of his pretending to be profound and you know there's something fishy; this kind of deadpan nonsense has the best comedic effect.
corpus-15.reflect: 直译基本准确，但"故作高深"和"一本正经的胡说八道"需要更地道的英文表达。"有猫腻"是口语，指有蹊跷；"一本正经的胡说八道"是网络常用说法，指严肃地讲胡话，英文里 deadpan nonsense 或 straight-faced nonsense 能传达同样效果。
corpus-15.free: Just look at that smug, know-it-all expression—you can tell something's up. That kind of straight-faced nonsense is comedy gold.

corpus-16.output: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you're always posting sunrises on your Moments.
corpus-16.direct: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you post sunrises on your Moments every day.
corpus-16.reflect: "我去" is an exclamation of surprise/realization, not "I go"; "不早说" means "why didn't you say earlier"; "朋友圈" is WeChat Moments; "晒" means to show off/post. Tone is playful realization.
corpus-16.free: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you're always posting sunrises on your Moments.

corpus-17.output: Nah, I'm not dating. These days love comes with a price tag.
corpus-17.direct: No deal, these days love is all clearly priced.
corpus-17.reflect: "不处" is slang for "不处对象" (not going to date/be in a relationship), so it means "I'm not dating" or "no relationship for me." "明码标价" means openly marked with a price tag—love has become transactional. Need to capture the cynical, casual tone.
corpus-17.free: Nah, I'm not dating. These days love comes with a price tag.

corpus-18.output: Not happening. Go play by yourself.
corpus-18.direct: No deal, go play by yourself.
corpus-18.reflect: "不处" is slang for "不处对象/不交往", i.e. refusing a relationship; "自己玩去" is a dismissive "go play by yourself." Direct version captures the refusal but "No deal" is a bit off—it's about rejecting a romantic/social advance, so something like "Not happening" or "No way" fits better.
corpus-18.free: Not happening. Go play by yourself.

corpus-19.output: Look — the winning numbers on the lottery ticket I bought are exactly the same as what you said yesterday.
corpus-19.direct: Look at the lottery ticket I bought — the winning numbers are exactly the same as what you said yesterday.
corpus-19.reflect: 直译准确，但英文口语里更自然的是用 'the numbers on the lottery ticket I bought' 或 'the winning numbers on my ticket'；'你看' 在这里是引起注意，用 'Look' 或 'Check it out' 都行。语气是惊讶/兴奋，需要保留。
corpus-19.free: Look — the winning numbers on the lottery ticket I bought are exactly the same as what you said yesterday.

corpus-20.output: Hakimi north-south mung beans—I'm dying trying not to laugh at my desk.
corpus-20.direct: Hakimi north-south mung beans, I'm holding it in at my workstation until I get internal injuries.
corpus-20.reflect: "哈基米南北绿豆" is a nonsense internet meme phrase (from a viral cat video song), not meant literally; "憋出内伤" means suppressing laughter/emotion so hard it hurts inside. Need to keep the meme feel and convey stifled laughter.
corpus-20.free: Hakimi north-south mung beans—I'm dying trying not to laugh at my desk.

corpus-21.output: Ran into this guy on the subway who kept muttering anime lines to himself the whole ride.
corpus-21.direct: On the subway I ran into a big bro who kept talking to himself in anime lines the whole way.
corpus-21.reflect: “大哥” here is a casual term for an older/macho stranger, best rendered as “guy” or “dude” rather than “big bro”; “动漫台词” means anime quotes/lines; “全程” = the whole ride. Tone is casual storytelling, so keep it colloquial.
corpus-21.free: Ran into this guy on the subway who kept muttering anime lines to himself the whole ride.

corpus-22.output: Stayed up late last night watching your livestream—laughed so hard my stomach hurt.
corpus-22.direct: Last night I stayed up late watching your livestream and laughed until my stomach hurt.
corpus-22.reflect: 直译准确自然，'laughed until my stomach hurt' 是英语中表达笑到肚子疼的地道说法，'stayed up late' 对应熬夜，语气轻松口语化，符合原句调侃氛围。
corpus-22.free: Stayed up late last night watching your livestream—laughed so hard my stomach hurt.

corpus-23.output: I was in such a rush to get out the door that I grabbed a rag instead of a towel and took it to work.
corpus-23.direct: In a hurry to go out, I directly took the rag to the company as a towel.
corpus-23.reflect: 直译基本准确，但"直接把抹布当毛巾带公司去了"的"当"应译为"mistook...for"或"used...as"更自然；"着急出门"用"rushed out"更口语化。
corpus-23.free: I was in such a rush to get out the door that I grabbed a rag instead of a towel and took it to work.

corpus-24.output: Not dating. This drama's too juicy—I can't even keep up.
corpus-24.direct: Not dating, the melon is too big to bite through.
corpus-24.reflect: "不处" is slang for "not dating / not in a relationship"; "瓜" is internet slang for gossip/drama, and "啃不动" means it's too much to handle/digest. Literal "melon too big to bite" would confuse English viewers.
corpus-24.free: Not dating. This drama's too juicy—I can't even keep up.

corpus-27.output: Isn't that how it should be?
corpus-27.direct: Isn't this what it should be?
corpus-27.reflect: 直译生硬，中文反问句表达的是“这本来就是理所当然的”，英文常用 Isn't that how it should be? 或 That's how it should be, isn't it? 语气上带反问、理所当然的意味。
corpus-27.free: Isn't that how it should be?

corpus-28.output: The boss is marrying the cleaning lady.
corpus-28.direct: The boss is going to marry the cleaning lady.
corpus-28.reflect: 直译准确自然，'保洁阿姨'译为 cleaning lady 符合英语口语习惯，'老板'用 the boss 即可。
corpus-28.free: The boss is marrying the cleaning lady.

corpus-29.output: Treadmill, elliptical, or spin bike—which is better for people who are overweight and trying to lose fat?
corpus-29.direct: Treadmill, elliptical, and spin bike—which is more suitable for a high-body-weight fat-loss group?
corpus-29.reflect: 直译基本准确，但"大体重减脂人群"直译生硬，英文更常说 people with a high body weight who want to lose fat；"动感单车"对应 spin bike/stationary bike，语气是提问，需保持自然疑问句。
corpus-29.free: Treadmill, elliptical, or spin bike—which is better for people who are overweight and trying to lose fat?

corpus-31.output: Oh man, I can't even—I'm gonna be laughing about this for a year. Come on, who hasn't had an embarrassing sanitary pad shopping story?

corpus-31.free: Oh man, I can't even—I'm gonna be laughing about this for a year. Come on, who hasn't had an embarrassing sanitary pad shopping story?

corpus-32.direct: I'm already running a fever, please let me go, aunties.
corpus-32.reflect: “大妈们”指爱跳广场舞/爱管闲事的中年妇女群体，直译 aunties 在英文里能传达这个群体感；“放过我吧”是求饶，let me go 自然。整体语气是无奈求饶，保留即可。
corpus-32.free: I'm already running a fever—please, aunties, just let me off the hook.

corpus-33.output: Watch Gen Z chat in their own internet slang
corpus-33.direct: Watch post-00s chat in Martian language
corpus-33.reflect: "火星文" refers to the stylized internet slang/leet-like text used by Chinese youth, not literal Martian; "00后" is the post-2000s generation. Need a natural English rendering that conveys watching young people chat in their own cryptic internet slang.
corpus-33.free: Watch Gen Z chat in their own internet slang

corpus-38.direct: Scrolling through videos, I saw a giant jianbing guozi made by a Shandong auntie, and suddenly I got curious: is Shandong jianbing the biggest in the whole country?
corpus-38.reflect: 直译基本准确，但'auntie'在英语里指亲属，指陌生大妈不自然，应改为'a woman'或'a lady'；'jianbing guozi'保留拼音可接受，但英文观众可能不熟，可加'tianbing'式说明；'got curious'稍生硬，用'wondering'更口语。
corpus-38.free: I was scrolling through videos and saw this huge jianbing guozi made by a Shandong lady — now I'm wondering, is Shandong jianbing the biggest in all of China?

corpus-39.free: Its 9.4 rating on Douban proves just how good it is.

corpus-40.output: I can't even—this is too much happiness all at once.
corpus-40.direct: I can't take it anymore, happiness came too suddenly.
corpus-40.reflect: “我不行了”在这里不是真的受不了，而是被幸福冲击得招架不住，英文口语常说 I can't even / I can't handle this；“幸福来得太突然”是网络流行语，表示好事来得猝不及防，直译稍显生硬，可用 this much happiness all at once 之类自然表达。
corpus-40.free: I can't even—this is too much happiness all at once.

corpus-41.output: Others: a fierce white-browed tiger. Me: a Chocliz ice cream bar.
corpus-41.direct: Others: white-browed tiger with upward-slanting eyes. Me: Qiaolezi ice cream.
corpus-41.reflect: “吊睛白额虎”是《水浒传》里对猛虎的经典描写，指眼睛上吊、额头有白斑的老虎，代表凶猛威武的形象；而“巧乐兹雪糕”是伊利旗下的一款普通雪糕，名字听起来像“巧克力兹”，形成强烈反差萌。这是网络对比梗，用“别人 vs 我”的格式制造幽默。直译“white-browed tiger with upward-slanting eyes”太长且英文观众不懂典故，需要简化处理，保留“猛虎 vs 雪糕”的反差感。

corpus-42.output: Hahaha I can't, netizens these days are just too creative
corpus-42.direct: Hahaha I can't anymore, this batch of netizens is really too talented
corpus-42.reflect: 直译基本准确，但"我不行了"是笑到受不了的口语表达，英文常说"I can't"或"I'm dying"；"这届网友"是网络流行说法，指这一代/这批网友，"太有才了"表示太有创意、太搞笑，用"too funny/creative"更自然。
corpus-42.free: Hahaha I can't, netizens these days are just too creative

corpus-44.output: I'm done—I've worked so much overtime I'm completely numb.

corpus-44.reflect: “我不行了”是口语化的崩溃感叹，“人都麻了”是网络流行语，表示累到麻木、没感觉了。直译基本达意，但“I can't anymore”稍显生硬，可用更地道的“I'm done”或“I can't take it anymore”；“麻了”用“numb”能传达麻木感，也可用“I'm so numb from all this overtime”更自然。
corpus-44.free: I'm done—I've worked so much overtime I'm completely numb.

corpus-45.free: I watch every single one of your videos. Your team's called, uh... Xiaochao Team, right? I remember it all!
